units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905

zones.comment: the 512x512 sunken start pad. In the .bsp it is a trigger_teleport to `Zyp1_start`, the raised 256x256 block in its middle, so all 120 spawns (stacked 4 high over the pad) drop onto it and are put on the block. Named here as the START so that it is claimed: left to the pit rule it would be a RESPAWN inflated to 192 units, over the block and every spawn -- a player spawned there would be respawned for ever
the raised block in the middle of the start pad, where the map itself puts every spawning player
around `zyp1_1`, the return point of section 1's lava (the 3328x768 trigger_teleport at z -1056)
around `zyp1_2`, where six pits at z -2528 return you
around `zyper2`, where seven pits at z -2528..-2984 return you; the section between zyp1_2 and Zyp2_1 by height and by position (its pits continue zyp1_2's to the north)
around `Zyp2_1`, where six pits at z -4792 return you
around `zyp3_1`, where fourteen pits and slabs at z -4792..-6760 return you
around `zyp4`, where sixteen pits at z -6584..-6824 return you
around `zyp5`, the last section: twenty-five pits at z -6088..-7176 return you here

the credits room at the end of zyp5: the wall at x 1400 carries zyper/new_mapby ('Map By Zyper'), the BHWC2020 logo and 12 tester/credit plates (zyper/askoT, danielT, krisT, ... pigeonT). The box starts 96 units into the room from the 96-wide walkway that is the only way in from the last pads, so it is crossed on entry. The middle of the floor is a func_illusionary over a trigger_teleport back to zyp5 -- the map's 'go again' -- and that is under this box, not before it

author: Zyper
notes: A Bhop World Cup 2020 map (bhwc2020/BHWC2 logo, zyper_bhwc20_* plates; the pakfile still carries the working name maps/1world_355.nav) with no triggers at all: the entity lump is 83 trigger_teleports, 11 destinations, spawns, lights and decoration, so the start and finish are what the geometry and the teleport graph say. The course is a descent through eight sections whose return points are named and fall in height order: Zyp1_start (-464), zyp1_1 (-944), zyp1_2 (-2352), zyper2 (-2992), Zyp2_1 (-4736), zyp3_1 (-4751), zyp4 (-6432), zyp5 (-6680); those are the stages. The START is the sunken 512x512 start pad all 120 spawns stand over, which teleports onto the block `Zyp1_start` in its middle. The FINISH is the credits room at the far end of zyp5, the lowest point of the map: its wall carries 'Map By Zyper', the BHWC logo and a dozen credit plates, and nothing lies beyond it. Three door-sized teleports are NOT the finish and are left as they are: `secret` (a 24-unit cube near the start) drops you into a sealed 96-unit glass cage at [2568 -4952 -6560] whose 16-unit teleport sends you back to `Zyp1_start`; `zypa` (a 32-unit cube high over the start of zyp5) and `zyper1` (a 224-unit pad over the zyper2 section) both lead to a secret room at [4400 7000 -6700] whose two exits return you to zyper2 or zyp5. DOUBTS: the room-as-finish is read from geometry and textures, not from an entity -- whatever timer zone BHWC ran it with was never in the .bsp; and the stages are boxes around the return points, which are where a section starts but not necessarily a place every route walks through.
